description: Allow-list of HIGH/CRITICAL npm-audit advisory IDs known and accepted at the workspace HEAD. Each entry must specify id (GHSA-*), package, severity, reason, expected_resolution. The CI gate (scripts/audit-check.sh, .github/workflows/ci.yml `npm:audit`) fails when `npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev --json` surfaces any HIGH/CRITICAL advisory whose id is not present here. Allow-list entries are time-bounded per ADR-0014 Decision 7. The 3 baseline PR-10 GHSA IDs (GHSA-2w69-qvjg-hvjx / GHSA-q3j6-qgpj-74h6 / GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc) were resolved via react-router-dom exact-pin (now 7.18.1) + fast-uri override. As of D-NPM-AUDIT-UPSTREAM-2 (2026-07-25) the list carries ONE entry, GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 — a fixless RSC-mode advisory not reachable in this client-only-SPA repo (see the entry's reason). CI gate fires on any NEW unlisted HIGH/CRITICAL finding.

advisories.reason: RSC Mode CSRF bypass — RSC mode is not in use anywhere in this repo: all three FE apps (ats/admin/portal-web) are client-only Vite SPAs; no createStaticHandler / StaticRouterProvider / RSC / server-component usage (verified by repo grep 2026-07-25). No forward fix exists: 7.18.1 is the latest published; npm's only fixAvailable is a breaking downgrade to 7.11.0 which reintroduces GHSA-chx6-hx7r-mcp5.
advisories.expected_resolution: Upgrade when upstream publishes a fixed release (>7.18.1 or fixed 8.x). Review by 2026-10-25; if still unfixed upstream, re-ratify or remediate.
